quitAndStopAllSessions.title: Quit Completely
quitAndStopAllSessions.message: Stop all terminal sessions and quit HiveWard?
quitAndStopAllSessions.detail: HiveWard closes every terminal tab and stops its session, including agents running in terminals, then quits. Plain Quit keeps them running so HiveWard reattaches on next launch. Terminal sessions on remote hosts may keep running there. Unsaved terminal work is lost, and the closed tabs don't come back on next launch. This can't be undone.
quitAndStopAllSessions.unavailableMessage: HiveWard can't stop every terminal session right now.
quitAndStopAllSessions.unavailableDetail: Nothing was stopped. Try again once your terminals have opened. If a terminal says it was opened in a newer version of HiveWard, reopen it first. If your terminals are already open, quit and reopen HiveWard, then try again.

copyChoice.cause: This usually happens after opening the profile in an older version of HiveWard.
copyChoice.sqliteOption: SQLite: what this version of HiveWard saved. Changes made in the older version are discarded.
copyChoice.jsonOption: JSON: includes changes made in the older version. Changes this version saved since then are discarded.
copyChoice.archiveNote: HiveWard archives both copies before switching, then restarts.

repairChoice.sectionStartsEmpty: {{section}}: no readable backup, so it will start empty.
repairChoice.projectsForgotten: HiveWard will forget your projects and their workspace details. Files on disk are not touched.
repairChoice.newerProjectsRemoved: Projects added after that backup will be removed from HiveWard, along with their workspace details. Files on disk are not touched.

repairChoice.message: Part of this profile's saved state is damaged.
repairChoice.restUnchanged: Everything else stays as it is now.
repairChoice.damagedCopyKept: HiveWard keeps a copy of the damaged file in its data folder, then restarts.

writeFailure.message: HiveWard has stopped saving this profile.
writeFailure.indeterminateDetail: HiveWard could not confirm whether your most recent change was saved. New changes will not be saved until you restart HiveWard.
writeFailure.safeDetail: Changes saved before this point are safe. New changes will not be saved until you restart HiveWard.

startupFailure.sectionsDamaged: Part of this profile's saved state is damaged: {{sections}}. Everything else is intact.
startupFailure.repairCommand: Stop HiveWard, then run `{{command}}` to replace only the damaged parts from backups and keep everything else. HiveWard keeps a copy of the damaged file.
startupFailure.restoreWholeBackup: To restore a whole backup instead, run `{{exportsCommand}}`, then `{{rollbackCommand}}`.
startupFailure.sqliteUnreadable: HiveWard cannot safely open the active profile because its SQLite state is unreadable.
startupFailure.chooseRecoveryArtifact: Stop HiveWard, then run `{{command}}` and choose a known-good recovery artifact.
startupFailure.restoreCommands: Restore SQLite with `{{backupCommand}}`, or restore a JSON export with `{{revisionCommand}}`.
startupFailure.authorityAmbiguous: HiveWard cannot safely choose a profile-state authority: {{detail}}
startupFailure.authorityBothPreserved: An older build may have changed the JSON file. Both copies are preserved; neither is selected automatically.
startupFailure.authorityCopyFirst: Stop HiveWard and copy the profile directory before choosing which state to keep.
startupFailure.authorityKeepJson: To keep the current JSON, including edits from an older build, run `{{command}}`. This archives both copies and does not merge their contents.
startupFailure.authorityInspect: Run `{{command}}` to inspect retained recovery points.
startupFailure.authorityRestore: Use `{{backupCommand}}` or `{{revisionCommand}}` only after selecting the state you want to restore.
startupFailure.newerSchema: This profile was saved by a newer version of HiveWard. Open it with that version or a newer release. Your profile has not been changed.
startupFailure.revisionConflict: The active profile changed while HiveWard was starting. Close other HiveWard processes using this profile, then restart HiveWard.
startupFailure.writerUnavailable: HiveWard could not start profile persistence. Restart HiveWard; if the problem continues, repair or reinstall this build.
startupFailure.publicationUnavailable: HiveWard could not safely publish profile state in {{directory}}.
startupFailure.publicationNeedsHardLinks: This location must support hard links, and HiveWard needs permission to create them.
startupFailure.publicationMoveData: Close HiveWard and hivewardd before checking folder permissions or moving the complete HiveWard data directory to a writable local filesystem that supports hard links, such as APFS, NTFS, or ext4.
startupFailure.publicationKeepFiles: Keep the original directory and all recovery files.
